title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-04-11
source: Partial Set 3; 7 Inch Half Track Reel Master @ 7.5 ips-Recorded by Bear (Reel # 4 Only); 1st Generation Cassettes(TDK SA-X 100's) Transferred By Dick Latvala; (Master Reel Playback on a Technics 1506 Reel 2 Reel-Tascam 122 MK111 Cassette Deck No Dolby); Analog to Digital Transfer (Cassettes played back on Nakamichi Dragon-Sony PCM-R500 DAT @ 44.1KHz by Jim Wise); Zero Gen DAT play back on a Sony PCM R-500-Digital Out @ 16/44.1kHz-Digital Audio Labs Card deluxe-WAV @ 16/44.1KHz; Editing(Adobe Audition CC)-Mastering & Processing (iZotope Ozone 6)-FLAC encoding(dBpoweramp)-Tagging(Tag & Re-name)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard snippet captures an inspired Lovelight performance, but the rest of the show is missing.
ai_review.review: Reviewers praise the crystal‑clear soundboard capture of the brief Love Light segment, noting Jerry Garcia’s soaring feedback solo and the band’s high energy. The main disappointment is that only a ~30‑minute excerpt is available, leaving fans longing for Dark Star > St. Stephen and the remainder of the concert.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high ratings (4‑5 stars) and enthusiastic comments about sound quality and performance, tempered by universal lament that only a fragment of the show is present.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the audio as crystal‑clear and excellent; no technical flaws are mentioned beyond the short length of the excerpt.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only a ~30‑minute Love Light segment is present, delivering high energy and tight playing, but the missing remainder of the set (including Dark Star > St. Stephen) leaves the flow incomplete.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry's feedback solo around 18:00 is highlighted as a standout moment.
